Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!

==== tinytapeout1 deviation from the stock template, read this ====
ERROR_ON_SYNTH_CHECKS gates the flow on yosys check errors, which are
multiple drivers on a net and combinational loops. This design has both,
on purpose, and neither can be removed without removing the point of the
chip. See PLAN.md and docs/AREA_GATE.md.
1. Each fabric site drives its output node from four tri-state
inverters of drive 1, 2, 4 and 8. That is how the genome selects the
ELECTRICAL realization. Muxing the variants instead would put the
mux between the selected driver and the load and make the selection
electrically invisible.
2. The load ladder hangs tri-state inverters on that node with a
permanently enabled keeper so the shared sink cannot float.
3. One combinational feedback edge closes the fabric column.
The guarantee yosys would have given us is replaced, not dropped.
tools/check_netlist.py runs in CI on the synthesized netlist and fails
if any tri-state enable was constant folded, if any shared tri-state net
has neither a common data input nor distinct enables, or if a drive
variant was optimized away. The drive enables are also decoded one-hot
in hardware, so contention is structurally impossible rather than
conventionally avoided.
